terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions govern access to and use of the FruitLogix platform (website, applications, and associated services). By using the platform, you accept the terms described below.

terms.s1.body: By accessing or using FruitLogix, the user declares to have read, understood, and accepted these Terms and Conditions in their entirety. If you do not agree with any provision, you should refrain from using the platform.
terms.s2.title: 2. Service Description
terms.s2.body: FruitLogix is a digital platform that connects agricultural producers, distributors, and commercial clients, offering real-time IoT monitoring, quality control, and logistics management throughout the fresh fruit supply chain.
terms.s3.title: 3. User Accounts and Responsibilities
terms.s3.body: The user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their access credentials and for all activity carried out under their account. They must provide truthful, complete, and up-to-date information when registering and using the service.

terms.s5.body: The software, design, brand, and content of FruitLogix are owned by its development team and are protected under applicable intellectual property law. Data uploaded by the user to the platform (harvest information, orders, inventory, etc.) remains their property.
terms.s6.title: 6. Privacy and Data Protection
terms.s6.body: FruitLogix collects and processes personal and operational data solely to provide the service: monitoring, traceability, and communication with the user. Data is not shared with third parties without consent, except where legally required.
terms.s7.title: 7. Professional Ethics and Responsibility in Software Engineering
terms.s7.intro: The FruitLogix development team commits to practicing software engineering in accordance with the principles of the ACM/IEEE-CS Software Engineering Code of Ethics and Professional Practice, as well as the Code of Ethics of the Peruvian College of Engineers (CIP). In particular, the team makes the following commitments:
terms.s7.li1: Public interest: prioritize the wellbeing, safety, and interests of users and society above particular interests.
terms.s7.li2: Client and stakeholders: act with honesty and integrity, fulfilling what was agreed with project stakeholders.
terms.s7.li3: Product quality: strive for the software to meet the highest possible professional standards, being transparent about its limitations.
terms.s7.li4: Independent professional judgment: maintain the integrity and independence of the team's technical judgment.
terms.s7.li5: Responsible management: promote an ethical approach to project management and foster collaboration among team members.
terms.s7.li6: Commitment to the profession: contribute to the reputation and advancement of software engineering as a discipline.
terms.s7.li7: Fair and respectful teamwork: support colleagues, recognize each member's contribution, and foster a collaborative environment.
terms.s7.li8: Continuous learning: participate in lifelong learning of professional practice.
terms.s7.closing: These principles guide both the technical and product decisions at FruitLogix, including responsible data use, information security, and transparency with end users.
terms.s8.title: 8. Development Process Transparency
terms.s8.body: The team documents its software engineering process through version control on GitHub, with a public history of commits, branches, and code reviews, as well as complementary evidence (screenshots and video) of the product lifecycle: planning, design, implementation, testing, and deployment. This documentation evidences professional responsibility and facilitates traceability of the technical decisions made during development.
terms.s8.galleryCaption: Screenshots of the commit history and the task board used by the team.
terms.s8.videoCaption: Video documenting the product lifecycle: planning, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to the Terms
terms.s10.body: These Terms may be updated periodically. Any relevant change will be notified through the platform. Continued use of the service after an update implies acceptance of the new terms.
terms.s11.title: 11. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
terms.s11.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Peru. Any dispute arising from their interpretation or application shall be submitted to the competent courts of Lima, Peru.
